purpose: Freeze exact upstream revisions before P1 baseline execution. Do not silently advance these revisions during one benchmark wave.

wave_1.license_status: AGPL-3.0-only with project-specific commercial authorization note
wave_1.reuse_policy: benchmark unmodified; do not copy or merge code into this repository without a separate compatibility decision
benchmark unmodified first; later code reuse is allowed only with copyright/license notice preservation and a passing single-variable experiment
benchmark execution and paper/method comparison only; do not copy repository code until an explicit license is located or permission is obtained
benchmark unmodified; treat memory/hook-ledger concepts as reference unless a separate AGPL-compatible integration decision is made

rules: If an upstream changes after frozen_at, record the new revision as a new benchmark wave rather than silently replacing this lock.
A documentation-only upstream HEAD is still a valid reproducibility lock; the exact tested tree must be recorded.
License status is an engineering boundary, not legal advice; uncertain status blocks code copying by default.
Method ideas may be independently reimplemented only after the experiment identifies a measured gap and the implementation avoids copying protected code or text.
